subject: 🎓 Congratulations, Graduate! — $ceremony_name
body:
Dear $student_name,

The $ceremony_name has now concluded, and it is our great pleasure to formally congratulate you on your graduation!

We hope you enjoyed celebrating your achievement with us. Your hard work and dedication have brought you to this milestone, and we could not be prouder to count you among our graduates.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CEREMONY DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Ceremony:     $ceremony_name
Date:         $ceremony_date
Time:         $ceremony_time
Venue:        $venue
Programme:    $course

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

  • Your official parchment/certificate will be issued and dispatched shortly.
  • Ceremony photographs and any recording will be made available via the Graduation Portal.
  • You are now eligible to join our Alumni community — stay connected for events, mentoring and networking.

If you have any questions about your award documents or post-ceremony arrangements, please contact the Graduation Office.

Once again, congratulations on this wonderful achievement. We wish you every success in the next chapter.

With warmest congratulations,
The Graduation Office
